//: Tests are typechecked separately because they legitimately use Node APIs the browser bundle must never see. Folding `types: [node]` into tsconfig.app.json instead would let application code reach for `fs` and still compile.
`exclude` must be reset to []: tsconfig.app.json excludes tests and `extends` inherits that, so without the override this project resolves to zero files and silently checks nothing.
`vite/client` is in `types` because tests import app modules that read import.meta.env, and specifying `types` at all opts out of automatic @types inclusion.
